item.title: TalaTek Brand Identity
item.description:
The TalaTek Media Productions identity pairs a star emblem with a high-contrast serif wordmark. A solid black square anchors the mark, an outlined star breaks past its edges, and a single golden-orange star at the centre carries the only colour in the design.

The lockup

TALATEK sits in large serif capitals with MEDIA PRODUCTIONS beneath it in wide letter-spaced caps, sharing the full width of the wordmark.

item.title: Messenger Theme Series
item.description:
TalaTek designed a set of illustrated themes for its Messenger group chat. Each theme is a three-panel composition set around familiar Olongapo City landmarks — the city public market and its slogan walls, the street with its white van and the bird monument, and the hillside of white crosses.

The scenes are drawn as flat 2D illustration so the artwork stays legible at chat background size, and the TalaTek star-and-wordmark lockup sits on top so the group reads as branded at a glance.
